summary: Production default. The published GSQ-RCO 2-bit build of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.

architecture.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
architecture.type: Mixture-of-experts transformer with linear-attention layers, n-gram per-layer embeddings (PLE) and a multi-token-prediction head

source.derivation: Published GGUF, used byte for byte

quantization.label: GSQ-RCO Q2_0
quantization.dense: mixed (BF16 routers, Q3_K to Q6_K, IQ4_XS)

memory.note: Inputs to the shared formula in config/runtime-policy.json. Resident model is the main file plus the MTP head; KV and buffers are the runtime's own plan at 131072 tokens and this model's prefill chunk. Routed experts are 48 layers x 512 experts of Q2_0, the same size for every model.

provenance.notes: Weights are the upstream files; SHA-256 verified against Hugging Face LFS metadata at install.

measured.mtp_benefit: +5.34 % median paired decode (20 of 25 parity-qualified synthetic pairs)

evidence.load, TTFT, prefill, decode: runtime parity run 2026-11-12 (5 short prompts and one 8.3K-token agent request, temperature 0)
evidence.mtp: Scope decode and MTP audit 2026-11-11; Swift build matched microcheck
evidence.peak wired: backend A/B 2026-11-12 (native, 8K and 32K prompts; whole machine, sampled every 2 s)

quality.name: Matched comparison against Swift LOW
quality.note: Aggregate quality 8.76; Swift LOW was faster but missed critical Ledger behaviour (2026-11-01)

quality.name: Latency decomposition
quality.note: Native inference is about 95 % of warm task time; decode 36 to 37 tok/s on real coding (2026-11-03)

quality.name: Stable-prefix restore
quality.note: Median first-token saving 21.1 s, median paired task-wall saving 5.65 % against a 15 % target

quality.name: Native adaptive MTP
quality.note: Median ON 32.35 tok/s against OFF 30.96 tok/s; real coding with MTP 37.95 tok/s median

quality.name: Opening-token probe (2026-11-12)
quality.note: Same 8.3K-token agent request, production sampling, 24 tokens each

splash-m1-1.6.1-ds1.status: integrated: all seven profiles pass on it (docs/BACKENDS.md); production backend chosen by config/runtime-policy.json

vision.source: ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF@ed59f92082b1e93c0e96d60a8b11aab089b52f09 (the BF16 projector the production Q8_0 copy was made from)

cache.policy: Splash's symmetric INT8 KV (per-token-head F32 scales), 32-token pages, prefix cache

memory.note: Splash's own plan for this model (/status): target weights plus the DFlash2 draft (0.49 GiB), INT8 KV at 131072 tokens, prefill/decode/state/pipeline/runtime reserves, BF16 vision. BF16 hyper-connection projections kept exact (0.58 GiB more than upstream's Q8_0). Measured peak wired 43.35 GiB (whole machine, backend A/B 2026-11-13).

splash-m1-1.6.1-ds1.speculative: DFlash2 draft (native MTP sidecar not used)
